acceptance.initial_training: one finite train loss, one finite validation loss, and a reloadable checkpoint
acceptance.resume: one additional finite train loss and validation loss from content-verified optimizer and RNG state
acceptance.fresh_reload: a separate process loads the resumed checkpoint and writes valid WAV audio
acceptance.frozen_generation: all 10 rows write valid audio and preserve failure observations
acceptance.objective_evaluation: all 10 rows receive complete required objective metric coverage

non_claims: The two optimization steps do not establish convergence or voice quality.
One row per split does not validate the full corpus or full lifecycle.
The run does not establish multi-GPU, alternative-runtime, or production-serving support.
Objective metrics do not establish accent fidelity, pronunciation, naturalness, or listening preference.
